In this checkout the Makefile is still there and there's no justfile, so `just test` won't work here. Your branch may differ from what I'm seeing.

The old `test-fast` target in the Makefile ran this:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

It skips tests marked `postgres`. Running that command directly works whatever the task runner is. If your `just test` recipe is just `pytest -q`, you can add a fast recipe to the justfile:

```just
test-fast:
    pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

Then you'd run `just test-fast`. I haven't confirmed that the `postgres` marker is the only thing that makes tests slow.
